If small-population disclosure or reconciliation tests fail, do not weaken acceptance criteria or authorization boundaries; keep the physical instance unverified and correct the package implementation within its approved CI020 scope.
After any rollback or forward recovery, rerun migration manifest, environment drift, recovery drill, GAP-PKG-019 package tests and the canonical regression facade before verification.
